subject: MAP milestone: Performance validation itinerary & proposed traffic-replay window
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acmeapps.com>, procurement@acmeapps.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0000
Subject: MAP milestone: Performance validation itinerary & proposed traffic-replay window

Hi Nina / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment on goals for the pilot. As promised, attaching an updated Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft_AcmeApps_v2.pdf) and a first-pass replay runbook. Key items for the performance/load milestone we discussed: 

- Objective: Validate peak QPS and 99th pct latency targets for the search-recommendation workload using traffic replay.
- Proposed primary window: 2027-07-14 02:00 - 06:00 UTC (4 hours) — this aligns with your low-production slice and our ops availability.
- Backup window: 2027-07-16 02:00 - 06:00 UTC.
- Target throughput: simulated peak of 18k QPS sustained for rolling 15-min intervals; short spikes to 24k QPS for up to 5 minutes to exercise autoscaling/backoff.
- Dedicated sizing suggestion: initial reservation of 8x H100-class GPUs (or equivalent Dedicated slot profile we discussed). Marissa included a capacity-sizing sheet with per-stage estimates.
- Dependencies: a) Your traffic export (sample) shared to our secure S3 mirror; b) whitelisted IPs for replay agents; c) a signed SOC2 Addendum (we can attach if procurement needs).

Please: 1) Confirm whether the primary window (Jul 14 UTC) works for your team; 2) Confirm traffic export cadence (we only need one 24h contiguous sample aligned to your peak day, scrubbed/pseudonymized as per our checklist); 3) Any procurement/PO timeline constraints we should know.

I flagged ownership for each MAP milestone in the attached PDF — the performance validation milestone has AcmeApps: provide traffic export & test acceptance criteria; Redwood: run orchestration, KV/prefix caching baseline, and post-test analysis.

Attachments: MAP_draft_AcmeApps_v2.pdf, replay-test-runbook.yml, capacity-sizing-sheet.xlsx

Next steps I propose: once you confirm the window, Rishi and Marissa will schedule the orchestration call (30 min) to walk through the runbook and failure-mode procedures. If the window is tight for your team, tell us preferred dates and we'll propose alternatives.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0107

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acmeapps.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, procurement@acmeapps.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Performance validation itinerary & proposed traffic-replay window

Thanks Karthik — quick technical clarifications from my side (ops lead):

Nina — two notes before we lock the window:
1) Sizing: the 8x H100 suggestion is conservative for the QPS profile you mentioned, but depends on sequence length and KV cache hit rate. If your median sequence length is <64 tokens and your KV cache hit looks >70%, we can likely validate with 6x H100. I added CPU & memory estimates in capacity-sizing-sheet.xlsx.

2) Traffic sample: please send a gzipped NDJSON export (one JSON per line) with these fields: timestamp, trace_id (pseudonymized ok), payload_size, endpoint, latency_ms (if available). We can accept up to 200GB — smaller is fine for initial smoke runs. 

3) Orchestration call: propose Tue Jul 06 16:00 UTC (30 min) — agenda: mapping traffic-to-traffic-replay rules, failure/fallback behavior, and clear rollback criteria. Rishi will own the orchestration playbook; I own capacity sizing and telemetry checks.

Delivery ownership in MAP (short):
- AcmeApps: provide traffic sample + procurement/PO signoff (target: Jul 09).
- Redwood (Marissa): confirm final Dedicated slot profile + test harness (target: Jul 10).
- Redwood (Rishi): run orchestration + post-test ops report (target: Jul 15).

If procurement needs a formal SOW or resource estimate for budgeting, I can produce a one-page appendix that lists test hours and reserved capacity cost estimate.

Marissa
Performance Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

----

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@acmeapps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeapps.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Performance validation itinerary & proposed traffic-replay window

Hi Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the clear breakdown and attachments. A few items from our side: 

- Jul 14 primary window looks feasible but I'd like to confirm with SRE before locking. Can we tentatively reserve it and confirm by EOD Jul 06?
- Traffic export: SRE prefers to hand off a 6-hour rolling capture containing the peak (we'll provide details this week). Is that sufficient for a representative replay? If not, we can provide the full 24h sample but will need additional time to scrub fields.
- Procurement: our PO team needs an itemized cost line for the dedicated-reservation hours and a brief statement that data will be isolated and not used for training. Could you send that appendix you mentioned (one-pager) and a standard SOC2 addendum?

Also cc'ing procurement box — procurement@acmeapps.com to track the PO timeline. For the orchestration call, Jul 06 at 16:00 UTC works for our SRE and myself. Please send calendar invite.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Director, Product Ops | AcmeApps
Nina.Patel@acmeapps.com

Subject: Re: MAP milestone: Performance validation itinerary & proposed traffic-replay window

Appreciate the quick responses team — locking next steps: 

1) Tentatively reserve Jul 14 02:00-06:00 UTC for the replay. Nina: we'll wait for your EOD Jul 06 confirmation to finalize the reservation and send a calendar hold.
2) Marissa: please attach the one-page appendix & the SOC2 addendum (procurement asked for the language). Karthik: please create the HubSpot task and upload the final MAP to the linked Drive folder.
3) Nina: 6-hour peak capture is acceptable for initial validation. We'll run a focused replay targeting the peak interval and then follow with a 24-hour extended run if you want deeper signal.

I'll run the orchestration call on Jul 06 16:00 UTC (Zoom) — agenda and invite to follow. Looks like owners and deadlines are in the MAP draft; procurement action item: PO by Jul 09 to ensure Dedicated reservation is in place.

Rishi
VP, Reliability Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
